title: Verb prefixes: one verb, many meanings
description: How prefixes on iść turn going into entering, leaving, arriving and crossing.

blocks.text: Prefixes add a direction or a nuance to a verb and usually make it perfective. With iść (to go on foot) they give a whole family: wejść (to go in), wyjść (to go out), przyjść (to arrive, come), przejść (to cross, go through), dojść (to reach), odejść (to walk away), zejść (to go down). The same prefixes work with jechać: wjechać, wyjechać, przyjechać. Learning the prefix meanings helps you guess new verbs.

blocks.translation: He left the house at eight.

blocks.text: Proszę przejść przez ulicę na światłach.
blocks.translation: Please cross the street at the lights.
We are leaving on holiday on Saturday.
blocks.note: Wy- with jechać: leaving by vehicle.
